summary: AI tools are supported for issues, pull requests, reviews and comments. A human must understand and take responsibility for the work, and AI-generated text must be clearly labelled and paired with human commentary. Fully autonomous agents are not accepted.

evidence.quote: We support the use of AI tools to help prepare issues, pull requests, reviews, or comments.
All contributions should involve a human who understands and can take responsibility for the work produced with AI assistance.
We do not accept contributions created by fully autonomous agents
AI-generated content in comments, issues, or PRs must be clearly disclosed and contained
AI-generated content must be accompanied by human commentary explaining its relevance.
Please do not respond to comments+questions by pasting raw or lightly reviewed AI-generated text.
